plugins.name: create-pr
plugins.description: Create HMCTS APIM pull requests with JIRA integration — extracts ticket from branch, drafts rich PR descriptions, and transitions JIRA status

plugins.name: setup-claude-md
plugins.description: Bootstrap a local .claude/CLAUDE.md with live @imports from apim-claude-template shared templates — run once per repo per developer

plugins.name: generate-repo-doc
plugins.description: Auto-generate a repo-specific CLAUDE.md template by reading OpenAPI spec, build files, source layout, and CI workflows — outputs to apim-claude-template/templates/repos/
